actions.cancel_subscription.description: Cancel a Chargebee subscription immediately, at end of term, or on a specific date.
actions.cancel_subscription.props.accoun: How to handle past due invoices when canceling immediately.
actions.cancel_subscription.props.cancel: UTC timestamp in seconds for when to cancel. Required when Cancel Option is "Specific Date".
When to cancel the subscription. Not applicable when the subscription has a contract term — use Contract Term Cancel Option instead.
Reason code from Settings > Configure Chargebee > Reason Codes > Subscriptions > Subscription Cancellation. Case-sensitive.
actions.cancel_subscription.props.contra: Required when the subscription has a contract term. Determines when to cancel the subscription and contract term.
actions.cancel_subscription.props.credit: How to handle credits for current term charges when canceling immediately.
Credit Option for Current Term Charges
actions.cancel_subscription.props.decomm: When true, all subscription operations will be disabled except deletion. This is irreversible.
actions.cancel_subscription.props.invoic: Document date displayed on the invoice PDF. Defaults to the current date. Provide to backdate the invoice.
actions.cancel_subscription.props.refund: How to handle refundable credits when canceling immediately.
actions.cancel_subscription.props.termin: The unique ID of the charge item price representing the termination fee. Used only when the subscription has a contract term.
Quantity for the termination fee. Applicable only for quantity-based item prices.
Service period of the termination fee in days, starting from the current date.
The termination fee in cents. For quantity-based items, this is the fee per unit.
actions.cancel_subscription.props.unbill: How to handle unbilled charges when canceling immediately.
actions.create_customer.props.allow_dire: Whether the customer can pay via Direct Debit.
actions.create_customer.props.auto_colle: Whether invoices should be automatically charged when possible.
actions.create_customer.props.billing_ad: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB).
actions.create_customer.props.invoice_no: A customer-facing note added to all invoices for this customer.
Key-value pairs to store extra information on the customer.
actions.create_customer.props.net_term_d: Number of days within which the customer must pay their invoices.
actions.create_customer.props.preferred_: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR). Requires Multi-currency pricing to be enabled.
actions.create_customer.props.taxability: Specifies if the customer is liable for tax.
actions.create_customer.props.vat_number: The VAT/tax registration number for the customer.
actions.create_subscription.description: Create a subscription for an existing customer using a Chargebee item price.
actions.create_subscription.props.auto_c: Whether to automatically charge the customer. Defaults to the customer setting.
actions.create_subscription.props.billin: Number of billing cycles before the subscription ends. Defaults to the item price setting.
actions.create_subscription.props.coupon: A coupon ID or code to apply to this subscription.
actions.create_subscription.props.invoic: Invoice any charges raised at creation time immediately rather than adding them to unbilled charges.
Customer-facing note added to all invoices for this subscription.
actions.create_subscription.props.item_p: The Chargebee item price ID to subscribe the customer to.
actions.create_subscription.props.meta_d: Key-value pairs to store extra information on the subscription.
actions.create_subscription.props.net_te: Number of days within which invoices for this subscription must be paid (Net D). Must match a value configured in Chargebee.
actions.create_subscription.props.paymen: ID of the payment source to attach to this subscription.
actions.create_subscription.props.po_num: Purchase order number to associate with this subscription.
actions.create_subscription.props.start_: UTC timestamp in seconds when the subscription starts. Defaults to now. Provide a past value to backdate.
actions.create_subscription.props.trial_: UTC timestamp in seconds when the trial period ends. Set to 0 for no trial.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_customer.description: Retrieve a customer from Chargebee by ID.
auth.description: Go to Settings > Configure Chargebee > API Keys and Webhooks > API Keys tab. Click Add an API Key, select Full-Access Key, and copy the generated key.
auth.props.api_key.description: Go to Settings > Configure Chargebee > API Keys and Webhooks > API Keys tab. Click Add an API Key, select Full-Access Key, and copy the generated key.
auth.props.site.description: Your Chargebee site subdomain. For acme.chargebee.com, enter acme.
description: Subscription billing and revenue operations platform for managing customers and subscriptions.
triggers.customer_created.description: Triggers when a new customer is created in Chargebee.
triggers.invoice_generated.description: Triggers when a new invoice is generated for a subscription.
triggers.payment_failed.description: Triggers when a payment attempt fails. Useful for dunning and retry workflows.
triggers.payment_succeeded.description: Triggers when a payment is successfully collected.
triggers.subscription_cancelled.descript: Triggers when a subscription is cancelled.
triggers.subscription_changed.descriptio: Triggers when a subscription is updated — plan change, quantity, or add-ons.
triggers.subscription_created.descriptio: Triggers when a new subscription is created for a customer.
triggers.subscription_renewed.descriptio: Triggers when a subscription is successfully renewed.
